name: Crunched
long_description:
Crunched is the Excel AI analyst for power users - in consulting, investment banking, and private equity. It error-checks workbooks end-to-end, builds models from scratch, and handles grunt work like extracting and linking data from IMs to template models - all within Excel so teams can review and iterate as usual.

Agents struggle with tabular data - getting reliable, multi-step execution over thousands of interlinked formulas, sheets, and ranges is hard. Making Crunched good enough for people who live in Excel means knowing the pain points deeply.

Michael and Philip has 10,000+ hours in Excel across consulting and finance. Markus and Lars bring deep expertise in scaling AI and enterprise solutions.

We've had easy access to first customers and are already live with firms across six European countries - we now plan to expand into the US. With >1bn total Excel users, we focus on the top 2%, highest-value Excel users globally. 

We're solving one pain point at a time to create a product that doesn't just look good in a demo but actually works in production.

Excel is here to stay, but the way experts model is fundamentally changing - with Crunched.

launches.title: Crunched - The AI Excel Analyst ⚡
launches.tagline: Crunched makes consultants & finance professionals >2x their Excel modeling speed
launches.body:
Hi YC 👋

We’re [Philip](https://www.linkedin.com/in/philip-z-borge-97690b149/), [Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-sakowski-9b9043148/), [Lars](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lars-g-mus%C3%A6us-756701174/) and [Markus](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markus-skagemo/) - and we’re building [Crunched](https://www.usecrunched.com/?utm_source=YC&utm_medium=post)

# **TL;DR**

**Crunched is the first AI Excel agent built by and for Excel power users**, tailored for management consulting and finance workflows

We’ve spent 10,000+ hours in Excel ourselves, and are live with consulting, IB and PE firms across Europe and the US, 2x-ing their Excel modeling speed

**_Ask:_** We would love for you to introduce us to mgmt. consulting, investment banking or PE firms - contact us at [philip@usecrunched.com](mailto:philip@usecrunched.com)

[**https://youtu.be/zBXue210_qo**](https://youtu.be/zBXue210_qo)

# **Why we’re doing it**

Michael and Philip have worked on countless deals at McKinsey and in other IB/PE roles, and it always starts and ends with an Excel model. It’s either the main deliverable itself, or the entire backbone of the slide deck.

No matter how skilled you are, manual Excel modeling is slow and super error-prone. On one of our last projects, a company’s 2030 revenue projection presented to the CEO was doubled because a colleague (promise it was a colleague), had linked the forecast to year 1 revenue growth for all years. That was a fun follow-up call afterwards.

Associates need specialized AI tools they can collaborate with directly in their workflows, to drive productivity and accuracy. The solution is not to replace Excel, but to augment it and solve one pain point at a time. That’s why we’re building Crunched.

# **What we’re doing**

Crunched is an Excel-native AI analyst that can:

1. **_Error-check models:_** Check models for logical, formula and conceptual mistakes
2. **_Gather data:_** Run targeted web research and extract figures from PDFs (e.g., annual reports) and link it into templates
3. **_Build analyses:_** Build bespoke analyses from scratch, turning 1h tasks into 5-10min automated workflows

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94760&key=user_uploads/2751214/b2d93de1-6fa0-44de-b6eb-3ec8197d190a)

Users are already reporting that they’re >2x faster on specific tasks. We are on a mission to make it 10x across all modeling work.

# **Team**

Michael and Philip have 10,000+ hours of Excel experience (often until 4am) from McKinsey. Lars and Markus have years of experience shipping and scaling award winning AI enterprise solutions, and are building Crunched with the cutting-edge security needed for clients to trust us with their highly confidential data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94760&key=user_uploads/2751214/b8c7c9db-f67a-4228-8db4-818620d713b7)

# **Ask**

**We’re expanding in Europe and into the US and are looking for warm intros** **to mgmt. consulting, IB and PE firms.** If you are or know any Excel power users we’d love your help.

Please reach out at [philip@usecrunched.com](mailto:philip@usecrunched.com) or book a live demo on [our website](https://usecrunched.com?utm_source=YC&utm_medium=post). All help is appreciated - **thank you!**
